lj_liquid.note: floor = mean over frame pairs at lag >= 4 (the decorrelated half; 21 of 45 pairs, residual short-lag correlation must not shrink the floor)

avg.method: floor of the frame-averaged statistic: per-frame observables averaged within disjoint frame groups, group-vs-group distance is one pair; A5 judges the ref_frames mean vs the mean of 3 rebuild draws at 1.5x max(mean, P90) of these pairs (review 3 / red-team F3; pair count >= 10 per case, O8)
avg.note: averaged floor = the rotated disjoint half-vs-half splits of the case's 10 frames (10 pairs, O8)

lj_liquid_large.note: floor = pooled decorrelated frame pairs of 2 independent trajectories (within-trajectory lag >= 2 plus cross pairs of the decorrelated halves; cross sits only +1%/+10% above within -- an equilibrated liquid carries no preparation memory, unlike the glass quenches; the second trajectory supplies the independent pairs the floor's upper quantile needs)

avg.note: averaged floor = trajectory-vs-trajectory mean-observables pair (5v5) plus the rotated disjoint 2v3 splits within each trajectory (11 pairs, O8)

lj_glass.note: floor = mean over the cross-quench frame pairs (last two, most-annealed frames of each of the 3 independent quenches, identical protocol, distinct seeds). Within-one-quench pairs of the same frames (intra_quench below) share the anneal basin and sit closer; a floor built from them is too tight for a perfect independent rebuild (Review 2).
